question.problem:
$$
{P}_{B\to C}=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -4 \\ -3 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

 

The change-of-coordinates matrix from the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}$ to the basis $C={{c}_{1},{c}_{2},{c}_{3}}$ is given above. Find $[x]_{C}$ given that $x=4{b}_{2}-2{b}_{1}-3{b}_{3}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that since $x=4{b}_{2}-2{b}_{1}-3{b}_{3},$ we have

$$
[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

 

Given the coordinates of $x$ relative to $B$ and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $B$ to $C,$ we find the coordinates of $x$ relative to $C$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\,x\,]_{C} & ={P}_{B\to C}[\,x\,]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -4 \\ -3 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 10 \\ -5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
